notes.winRate: Wins divided by wins plus losses; ties are tracked but excluded from win-rate denominator.
notes.metricEligibility: Metric calculations exclude standings marked invalid because required data could not be resolved, plus standings where the player dropped on game 1.
notes.usagePercent: Player records with the item divided by player records with public teams in this stats file scope.
notes.detailMinimum: Top Pokemon detail lists only include entries with at least 1% usage within their modal detail context.
